$comment: Curated Claude Code permission baseline for this repository, adopted from idd-skill's own dogfood .claude/settings.json (not the conservative idd-template/.claude/settings.json opt-in counterpart) because this repository records mergePolicy: fully_autonomous_merge -- see docs/idd-policy.md#claude-code-permission-baseline-claudesettingsjson and docs/permissions.md#claude-code-permission-baseline for the rationale, scope, and known flag/path matching gotchas. `gh api` is deliberately NOT allowlisted here (see the gh-api DELETE-verb trap in docs/permissions.md); the DELETE-verb deny entries below are defense in depth if a future edit adds one back. Deliberately dropped upstream's `Bash(node scripts/*)` / `Bash(node bin/*)` allow entries: those exist in idd-skill's own dogfood file because that repository IS the vendored-node source tree; under this repository's package-manager profile the idd-* helpers run through `pnpm exec`/package.json scripts instead, this repository has no bin/ directory at all, and its own scripts/ holds only isPrerelease.mjs/createEntryStub.mjs release utilities -- keeping the wildcard would only widen the attack surface with no corresponding benefit here. Personal additions belong in .claude/settings.local.json, which layers on top of this file.
